data.summary:
This errata changes the Tempestus Aquilons in 3 ways:

- Their **bolt pistol** has BS 3+.
- [Servo-sentry](vsdata:ability/astra-militarum.tempestus-aquilons.servo-sentry): when this unit arrives by **[Deep Strike](vsdata:core-ability/deep-strike)**, the Tempestor Aquilon may fire its sentry weapon (the sentry hot-shot volley gun, sentry flamer or sentry grenade launcher).
- [Precision Drop](vsdata:ability/astra-militarum.tempestus-aquilons.precision-drop): if this unit arrives by **[Deep Strike](vsdata:core-ability/deep-strike)** in your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), it may make a precision drop and be set up anywhere over 6" horizontally from every enemy unit, after which it cannot declare a [charge](vsdata:core-rule/charge-phase) until the end of the turn.
